traditional: 改編自莎士比亞作品嘅 + N
jyutping: goi2 pin1 zi6 saa1 si6 bei2 aa3 zok3 ban2 ge3 N

english.note: Use this specifically for a work or thing adapted or derived from one of Shakespeare's works.

examples.english: This film is a modern love story adapted from a Shakespearean work.
examples.traditional: 呢套電影係改編自莎士比亞作品嘅現代愛情故事。
